todos.title: Document Security Policies
todos.description: Create and document all security policies including access control, data protection, incident response, and acceptable use policies.

todos.title: Conduct Risk Assessment
todos.description: Perform a comprehensive risk assessment to identify potential threats, vulnerabilities, and their potential impact on the organization.

todos.title: Implement Access Controls
todos.description: Set up role-based access controls (RBAC), ensure least privilege principle is followed, and document all access rights.

todos.title: Review Vendor Security
todos.description: Assess all third-party vendors for security compliance, request SOC2 reports, and document vendor risk assessments.

todos.title: Security Awareness Training
todos.description: Conduct security awareness training for all employees covering phishing, password hygiene, and data handling procedures.

todos.title: Establish Incident Response Plan
todos.description: Create and document an incident response plan including roles, communication procedures, and recovery steps.

todos.title: Implement Data Encryption
todos.description: Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Document encryption methods and key management procedures.

todos.title: Setup Backup & Recovery
todos.description: Implement backup procedures, test recovery processes, and document RPO/RTO objectives.

todos.title: Configure Logging & Monitoring
todos.description: Set up centralized logging, security monitoring, and alerting for suspicious activities.

todos.title: Establish Change Management
todos.description: Document change management procedures including approval workflows, testing requirements, and rollback plans.
